name: agentic-change-audit
description: Evidence-first audits for AI-generated and human software changes before merge, release, or deployment.

interface.longDescription: Agentic Change Audit reviews a fixed software change, records the checks and evidence actually available, identifies findings and required human checks, and returns one structured Verdict before merge, release, or deployment. It is evidence-first, agent-neutral, and read-only by default.
defaultPrompt: Audit the current repository change without modifying files. Fix the result to the current base and target HEAD.
Audit this AI-built application as a release candidate and identify missing evidence and required human checks.
Re-audit the approved remediation against the previous findings and authorized scope.
